title: Transcript
description: The content of a transcript artifact version (FR-MTG-02; ADR-0018 store, application/json, inside the 2,000,000-byte text cap; ADR-0020). Ingest writes it; utterance ids strictly increase (PE-22, validator). Owner-only (PE-05): another person gets at most one `evidence_quote`, cut per request by tilo-api (PE-23). Speaker labels and text are untrusted.

utterance.description: One utterance: the speaker label as captioned or uploaded (untrusted, not a person id) and the offset from the start of the meeting.

evidence_quote.description: One evidence quote as tilo-api serves it (ADR-0020): a read-model row computed per request from the pinned transcript version, never stored, logged, archived, sent or put in an event or a prompt (PE-22). Code removes control and format characters and cuts the text at 240 characters on a word boundary (`truncated`); for a viewer other than the meeting owner it masks addresses, phone numbers and links, and the speaker is a teammate's display name or null (PE-24). Only `shown` carries text (PE-25).

evidence_quotes.description: The answer of a quote request: one quote per requested utterance for the meeting owner, at most one for a work item's owner, none when the item cites nothing (PE-23).

quote_line.description: Quote text or speaker: one line of at most 240 characters with no control character (Cc), no line or paragraph separator and no format character (Cf) of the Basic Multilingual Plane, so no bidi override or zero-width character. Astral format characters (tag characters U+E0000 to U+E007F and others) are removed by code (PE-24, validator only).
